title: andira anthelminthica var. acuminata
intro: Andira anthelminthica var. acuminata, commonly known as the "Andira tree," is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues and parasitic infections, due to its health benefits of promoting digestive health and reducing inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions include anthelmintic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating a range of health issues. The bioactive constituents of Andira anthelminthica var. acuminata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
